skill.description: Skill name exactly as the JD requirements list it

evidence.description: Quote copied from the CV that supports the verdict; null when NOT_MET

tier.description: Evidence tier of the matched skill: 0 none, 1 listed, 2 used, 3 used often, 4 proficient (CONTEXT D44)

via.description: Catalogue skill of the CV the match goes through for IMPLIED and FAMILY; null for EXACT and NONE

sources.description: CV entries the tier rests on: experience, projects, certificates, then the skills list

title: MatchSkillVerdict
description: Verdict on one skill of the JD, computed by code, with the CV entries it rests on
